title: WorkflowManifest
description: Definition manifest for a Pocket-Agents workflow

workflowStep.description: A single step in a workflow

stepId.description: Unique identifier for this step within the workflow

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent to invoke for this step

toolIds.description: List of tool identifiers available to the agent during this step

inputMapping.description: Optional mapping of workflow context keys to agent input keys

outputKey.description: Optional key under which to store this step's output in workflow context

description.description: Human-readable description of what this workflow does

steps.description: Ordered list of steps to execute sequentially
